body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Toshiba(www.toshiba.com) introduced faster external hard drive 'Cavino 3.0' by upgrading with USB 3.0 at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA, for 4 days from January 6. Capacity is 500GB / 750GB / 1TB.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
